summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an 8-K current report) announcing an increase to the maximum tender amount of its issuer tender offer for its outstanding $3.0bn 6.000% Perpetual Subordinated Contingent Convertible Securities, from $1.0bn to $1.5bn aggregate principal, at a purchase price of 100.50% ($1,005 per $1,000 principal) plus accrued interest. The offer, dated 5 November 2026, expires 19 November 2026 with expected settlement 24 November 2026, is conditioned on a concurrent $1.5bn 7.625% CoCo issuance, and aims to proactively manage Tier 1 capital. Watch take-up versus the maximum amount, proration risk, withdrawal mechanics, and completion of the new issuance as the key condition.
